verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's entire premise is natural-language driven coding/agentic actions (querying codebases, debugging, automating PR/rebase tasks, custom GEMINI.md context) per gemini-cli-gh-1/3/4/9. However, multiple hands-on reports describe the NL-agent behavior failing badly in practice — getting stuck in error loops, botching file edits, ignoring GEMINI.md instructions, and in one case catastrophically deleting user data via misinterpreted commands.
